name: Spa
source: public: open-data centreline and widths (SPW Orthophotos 2024 white lines, tools/track/centreline_fit.py); road height and banking fitted to SPW Relief de la Wallonie - MNT 2021-2022 (LiDAR, 0.5 m) (CC BY 4.0); registered to OSM
attribution: Centreline and widths: fitted to the white edge lines in Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Orthophotos 2024 (CC BY 4.0), tools/track/centreline_fit.py
Search seed: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), highway=raceway ways (tools/track/osm_seed.py); no OSM geometry is output
Track frame: fixed transform to EPSG:3812 (tracks/spa/georef.json)
Elevation: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Relief de la Wallonie - Modele Numerique de Terrain (MNT) 2021-2022 (CC BY 4.0)
Kerbs: detected in Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Orthophotos 2024 (CC BY 4.0)
types_note: grip values and the type rule are PLACEHOLDERS (docs/models/road-surface.md §5)

provenance.grid: 13995 rows x 181 nodes, ds = 0.499999 m, dn = 0.25 m, >= 10.0 m beyond each white line
provenance.kerbs: tracks/spa/kerbs.json: kerbs detected in the open orthophoto (open orthophoto only (CC BY 4.0); docs/models/kerb-detection.md); the regularised kerbs (regular_bands: bridged, smoothed width, height taper at the ends) placed from our white line outward, width clipped to [0.3, 3.0] m; profile ASSUMPTION: linear rise to 0.05 m at the outer edge (lower when narrower than 1.0 m), 0.2 m outer ramp; painted run-off areas and the paved extent seen in the photo (paved_d_1m) typed RunoffAsphalt; kerb types from tracks/spa/kerb_types.json (flat / ridged / sausage / paint, docs/models/kerb-types.md): sausage and paint profiles in the grid, ridges analytic in the core from the header's kerb records; reviewed walls of tracks/spa/wall_review.json (la_source_to_eau_rouge_right right s 684-1046 m): Barrier from the wall face for its thickness, OffGrid beyond
provenance.types: asphalt inside the white lines; kerb band; run-off asphalt 3.0 m (and painted run-off); then the site's ground classes (tracks/spa/ground.png, nearest 0.5 m pixel): gravel -> Gravel, paved and paint -> RunoffAsphalt, else Grass

registration.method: trimmed ICP (8 m) of the centreline every 2 m onto OSM highway=raceway ways densified to 1 m (point-to-line steps); scale locked to 1

ground.source: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Orthophotos 2024 (2026-01-15), CC BY 4.0; LiDAR: public: SPW Relief de la Wallonie - MNT 2021-2022 (LiDAR, 0.5 m)
ground.rule: nodes beyond the paved strip: gravel -> Gravel, paved / paint -> RunoffAsphalt, else Grass (docs/models/road-surface.md §5)
